div.div:
Shared channel weights are learned across pixels; there is no dense all-pixel predictive matrix. Both hidden branches contribute to the same canvas update.
Source ON/OFF evidence is distinct from missing samples. Preserve pre-evidence predictions for the UI. No additional canvas-minus-prior restoring force.
New inter-region edges must name their operator: spatial conductance, predictive coupling, or another explicit rule. Arbitrary edges are not part of the first shader port.
